```{r}
merge_experiment_results <- function(experiment_results_base, experiment_results_hub) {
  tps <- intersect(names(experiment_results_base), names(experiment_results_hub))
  if (length(tps) == 0L) stop("No common timepoints between base and hub results.")
  setNames(
    lapply(tps, function(tp) {
      # rows = experiments, cols = genes
      s_base <- experiment_results_base[[tp]][["stats"]]
      s_hub  <- experiment_results_hub [[tp]][["stats"]]
      if (is.null(s_base) || is.null(s_hub)) {
        stop("Missing $stats at timepoint: ", tp)
      }
      s_all <- rbind(s_base, s_hub)
      list(stats = s_all)
    }),
    tps
  )
}
```

```{r}
de_top200_q50 <- map(de_top200, function(df) {

  # compute 90% quantile of absolute logFC within this table
  q50 <- quantile(abs(df$logfc), probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)

  df %>%
    filter(abs(logfc) >= q50) %>%        # keep top 10% effect sizes
    filter(pval < 0.05) %>%              # significance filter
    arrange(desc(abs(logfc)))                 # sort by logFC (largest positive first)
})
  
de_top200_q95 <- map(de_top200, function(df) {

  # compute 90% quantile of absolute logFC within this table
  q95 <- quantile(abs(df$logfc), probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

  df %>%
    filter(abs(logfc) >= q95) %>%        # keep top 10% effect sizes
    filter(pval < 0.05) %>%              # significance filter
     arrange(desc(abs(logfc)))                 # sort by logFC (largest positive first)
})

de_top200_q90 <- map(de_top200, function(df) {

  # compute 90% quantile of absolute logFC within this table

  df %>%
    filter(abs(logfc) >= q90) %>%        # keep top 10% effect sizes
    filter(pval < 0.05) %>%              # significance filter
     arrange(desc(abs(logfc)))                 # sort by logFC (largest positive first)
})
```

```{r}
k_hop_descendants <- function(A, targets, k = 1) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)
  targets <- unique(targets)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  frontier <- targets
  visited[frontier] <- TRUE

  desc <- integer(0)

  for (step in seq_len(k)) {

    # children of current frontier: edge frontier -> child
    children <- which(colSums(A[frontier, , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    children <- setdiff(children, which(visited))

    if (!length(children)) break

    desc <- c(desc, children)
    visited[children] <- TRUE
    frontier <- children
  }

  unique(desc)
}


all_downstream <- function(A, targets) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  stack <- targets
  visited[stack] <- TRUE

  desc <- integer(0)

  while (length(stack)) {

    children <- which(colSums(A[stack, , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    children <- setdiff(children, which(visited))

    if (!length(children)) break

    desc <- c(desc, children)
    visited[children] <- TRUE
    stack <- children
  }

  unique(desc)
}



score_downstream <- function(de_list,
                                      A,
                                      exp_design,
                                      step = NULL,     # NULL = all downstream
                                      top_x = NULL,
                                      exp_subset = NULL,
                                      alpha = 0.5 ) {

  genes <- colnames(exp_design)
  gene_to_idx <- setNames(seq_along(genes), genes)

  exps <- names(de_list)
  if (!is.null(exp_subset)) {
    exps <- intersect(exps, exp_subset)
  }

  res <- data.frame()

  for (e in exps) {

    dt <- de_list[[e]]
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next

    if (!is.null(top_x)) {
      dt <- head(dt, top_x)
    }

    # top DEGs
    S_true <- dt$gene
    S_true_idx <- gene_to_idx[S_true]

    # perturbed nodes
    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[exp_design[e, ] != 0]
    pert_idx <- gene_to_idx[pert_genes]

    # downstream set
    S_down_idx <- if (is.null(step)) {
      all_downstream(A, pert_idx)
    } else {
      k_hop_descendants(A, pert_idx, k = step)
    }

    # exclude perturbed nodes themselves
    S_down_idx <- setdiff(S_down_idx, pert_idx)
    S_down <- genes[S_down_idx]

    # DEGs NOT explained by downstream
    n_miss <- length(setdiff(S_true, S_down))
    miss_rate <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else n_miss / length(S_true)

    # Useless downstream (precision penalty)
    n_noise <- length(setdiff(S_down, S_true))
    noise_rate <- if (length(S_down) == 0) 0 else n_noise / length(S_down)


    neg_score <- alpha * miss_rate + (1 - alpha) * noise_rate

    res <- rbind(
      res,
      data.frame(
      experiment = e,
      step = ifelse(is.null(step), "all", step),
      top_x = length(S_true),
      miss_rate = miss_rate,
      noise_rate = noise_rate,
      negative_score = neg_score,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
  }

  res
}

```



```{r}
top_x_vals <- seq(10, 50, by = 10)

neg_scores <- lapply(top_x_vals, function(tx) {

  t_res <- score_downstream(
    de_top200,
    adj_truth,
    exp_design,
    step = 1,
    top_x = tx,
    exp_subset = test_exp
  ) %>%
    mutate(group = "Truth")

  r_res <- score_downstream(
    de_top200,
    random_adj,
    exp_design,
    step = 1,
    top_x = tx,
    exp_subset = test_exp
  ) %>%
    mutate(group = "Random")

  bind_rows(t_res, r_res)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

summary_stats <- neg_scores %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(negative_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(negative_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
pvals <- neg_scores %>%
  group_by(top_x) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = {
      truth_scores  <- negative_score[group == "Truth"]
      random_scores <- negative_score[group == "Random"]

      if (length(truth_scores) > 0 && length(random_scores) > 0) {
        wilcox.test(
          x = truth_scores,
          y = random_scores,
          alternative = "less"
        )$p.value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = paste0("p = ", formatC(p_value, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
```

```{r}
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("Causal Reach Violation + noise penalty") +
  ggtitle("Causal Reach Violation\nOne-sided Wilcoxon: Truth < Random")

print(p)
```

```{r}
make_partial_graph <- function(adj_truth, correct_frac, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  A <- adj_truth
  p <- nrow(A)

  # 所有可能的有向边（不含自环）
  all_edges <- which(row(A) != col(A), arr.ind = TRUE)

  # True edges
  true_edges <- which(A == 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
  E <- nrow(true_edges)

  # False edges = 非真实边
  false_edges <- all_edges[!apply(all_edges, 1, function(x)
    any(x[1] == true_edges[, 1] & x[2] == true_edges[, 2])
  ), , drop = FALSE]

  n_keep <- round(correct_frac * E)
  n_flip <- E - n_keep

  keep_idx <- sample(seq_len(E), n_keep)
  keep_edges <- true_edges[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]

  new_edges <- false_edges[sample(seq_len(nrow(false_edges)), n_flip), , drop = FALSE]

  # build new adjacency
  A_new <- matrix(0, p, p)
  A_new[keep_edges] <- 1
  A_new[new_edges] <- 1

  A_new
}
```

```{r}
calc_scores_for_graphs <- function(graph_list,
                                   de_list,
                                   exp_design,
                                   top_x_vals,
                                   exp_subset = NULL,
                                   step = NULL,
                                   graph_group = NULL) {
  # graph_list: named list of adjacency matrices
  # de_list: list of DE tables by experiment
  # exp_design: design matrix (rows=experiments, cols=genes)
  # top_x_vals: vector, e.g. seq(10, 50, by = 10)
  # exp_subset: optional vector of experiment names
  # step: NULL means all upstream (as in your score_negative_upstream)
  # graph_group: optional label for grouping, e.g. "low"/"high"

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(graph_list), function(name) {
    A <- graph_list[[name]]

    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(top_x_vals, function(tx) {
      score_downstream(
        de_list   = de_list,
        A         = A,
        exp_design = exp_design,
        step      = step,
        top_x     = tx,
        exp_subset = exp_subset
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          graph = name,
          graph_group = graph_group,
          top_x = tx
        )
    }))
  }))
}
```

```{r}
    )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
```

# 
AdjScore=Violation−E[Violationrandom​]

```{r}

sample_random_graph_same_edges <- function(A,
                                           allow_self_loops = FALSE) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- nrow(A)
  stopifnot(ncol(A) == p)
  
  # 原图边数
  m <- sum(A != 0)
  
  # 所有候选边位置 (i != j)，不允许自环
  if (!allow_self_loops) {
    cand <- which(row(A) != col(A), arr.ind = TRUE)
  } else {
    cand <- which(matrix(TRUE, nrow = p, ncol = p), arr.ind = TRUE)
  }
  
  n_cand <- nrow(cand)
  if (m > n_cand) {
    stop("Number of edges in input graph exceeds possible edges under current constraints.")
  }
  

  sel_idx <- sample(seq_len(n_cand), size = m, replace = FALSE)
  sel_edges <- cand[sel_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  

  A_rand <- matrix(0L, nrow = p, ncol = p)
  A_rand[as.matrix(sel_edges)] <- 1L
  

  diag(A_rand) <- 0L
  rownames(A_rand) <-rownames(A)
  colnames(A_rand) <- colnames(A)
  
  A_rand
}



compute_violation_one_graph <- function(A,
                                        de_list,
                                        exp_design,
                                        step = NULL,
                                        top_x = NULL,
                                        exp_subset = NULL) {

  genes <- colnames(exp_design)
  gene_to_idx <- setNames(seq_along(genes), genes)

  exps <- names(de_list)
  if (!is.null(exp_subset)) {
    exps <- intersect(exps, exp_subset)
  }

  vals <- numeric(0)

  for (e in exps) {

    dt <- de_list[[e]]
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next

    if (!is.null(top_x)) {
      dt <- head(dt, top_x)
    }

    S_true <- dt$gene
    S_true_idx <- gene_to_idx[S_true]

    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[exp_design[e, ] != 0]
    pert_idx <- gene_to_idx[pert_genes]

    S_down_idx <- if (is.null(step)) {
      all_downstream(A, pert_idx)
    } else {
      k_hop_descendants(A, pert_idx, k = step)
    }

    S_down_idx <- setdiff(S_down_idx, pert_idx)
    S_down <- genes[S_down_idx]

    n_miss <- length(setdiff(S_true, S_down))
    viol <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else n_miss / length(S_true)

    vals <- c(vals, viol)
  }

  mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
}


ompute_random_baseline <- function(A,
                                    de_list,
                                    exp_design,
                                    step = NULL,
                                    top_x = NULL,
                                    exp_subset = NULL,
                                    n_random = 100) {

  v_rand <- numeric(n_random)

  for (i in seq_len(n_random)) {

    A_rand <- sample_random_graph_same_edges(A)

    v_rand[i] <- compute_violation_one_graph(
      A_rand,
      de_list,
      exp_design,
      step = step,
      top_x = top_x,
      exp_subset = exp_subset
    )
  }

  list(
    mean = mean(v_rand, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(v_rand, na.rm = TRUE),
    all  = v_rand
  )
}

compute_adjusted_score <- function(A,
                                   de_list,
                                   exp_design,
                                   step = NULL,
                                   top_x = NULL,
                                   exp_subset = NULL,
                                   n_random = 100) {

  v_real <- compute_violation_one_graph(
    A,
    de_list,
    exp_design,
    step = step,
    top_x = top_x,
    exp_subset = exp_subset
  )

  rand_stats <- compute_random_baseline(
    A,
    de_list,
    exp_design,
    step = step,
    top_x = top_x,
    exp_subset = exp_subset,
    n_random = n_random
  )

  adj <- v_real - rand_stats$mean

  data.frame(
    violation_real = v_real,
    violation_random_mean = rand_stats$mean,
    violation_random_sd = rand_stats$sd,
    adjusted_score = adj
  )
}



score_downstream_adjusted <- function(de_list,
                                      A,
                                      exp_design,
                                      step = NULL,
                                      top_x = NULL,
                                      exp_subset = NULL,
                                      n_random = 100) {

  genes <- colnames(exp_design)
  gene_to_idx <- setNames(seq_along(genes), genes)

  exps <- names(de_list)
  if (!is.null(exp_subset)) {
    exps <- intersect(exps, exp_subset)
  }

  res <- data.frame()

  for (e in exps) {

    dt <- de_list[[e]]
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next

    if (!is.null(top_x)) {
      dt <- head(dt, top_x)
    }

    S_true <- dt$gene
    S_true_idx <- gene_to_idx[S_true]

    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[exp_design[e, ] != 0]
    pert_idx <- gene_to_idx[pert_genes]

    get_down <- function(A_mat) {
      idx <- if (is.null(step)) {
        all_downstream(A_mat, pert_idx)
      } else {
        k_hop_descendants(A_mat, pert_idx, k = step)
      }
      genes[setdiff(idx, pert_idx)]
    }

    ## real violation
    S_down_real <- get_down(A)
    n_miss_real <- length(setdiff(S_true, S_down_real))
    viol_real <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else n_miss_real / length(S_true)

    ## random baseline
    viol_rand <- numeric(n_random)

    for (i in seq_len(n_random)) {

      A_rand <- sample_random_graph_same_edges(A)

      S_down_rand <- get_down(A_rand)
      n_miss_rand <- length(setdiff(S_true, S_down_rand))

      viol_rand[i] <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else n_miss_rand / length(S_true)
    }

    viol_rand_mean <- mean(viol_rand, na.rm = TRUE)

    adj_score <- viol_real - viol_rand_mean

    res <- rbind(
      res,
      data.frame(
        experiment = e,
        step = ifelse(is.null(step), "all", step),
        top_x = length(S_true),
        violation_real = viol_real,
        violation_random_mean = viol_rand_mean,
        negative_score = adj_score,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  res
}
```

# try direct low-value penalty


```{r}

k_hop_descendants <- function(A, targets, k = 1) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)
  targets <- unique(targets)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  frontier <- targets
  visited[frontier] <- TRUE

  desc <- integer(0)

  for (step in seq_len(k)) {

    # children of current frontier: edge frontier -> child
    children <- which(colSums(A[frontier, , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    children <- setdiff(children, which(visited))

    if (!length(children)) break

    desc <- c(desc, children)
    visited[children] <- TRUE
    frontier <- children
  }

  unique(desc)
}


all_downstream <- function(A, targets) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  stack <- targets
  visited[stack] <- TRUE

  desc <- integer(0)

  while (length(stack)) {

    children <- which(colSums(A[stack, , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    children <- setdiff(children, which(visited))

    if (!length(children)) break

    desc <- c(desc, children)
    visited[children] <- TRUE
    stack <- children
  }

  unique(desc)
}


score_downstream <- function(de_list,
                             A,
                             exp_design,
                             step = NULL,
                             top_x = NULL,
                             exp_subset = NULL) {

  genes <- colnames(exp_design)
  gene_to_idx <- setNames(seq_along(genes), genes)
  N_nodes <- length(genes)

  lambda <- 2 / N_nodes   # regularization weight

  exps <- names(de_list)
  if (!is.null(exp_subset)) {
    exps <- intersect(exps, exp_subset)
  }

  res <- data.frame()

  for (e in exps) {

    dt <- de_list[[e]]
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next

    if (!is.null(top_x)) {
      dt <- head(dt, top_x)
    }

    ## true DEGs
    S_true <- dt$gene

    ## perturbed nodes
    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[exp_design[e, ] != 0]
    pert_idx <- gene_to_idx[pert_genes]

    ## downstream
    S_down_idx <- if (is.null(step)) {
      all_downstream(A, pert_idx)
    } else {
      k_hop_descendants(A, pert_idx, k = step)
    }

    S_down_idx <- setdiff(S_down_idx, pert_idx)
    S_down <- genes[S_down_idx]

    ## causal violation
    n_miss <- length(setdiff(S_true, S_down))
    miss_rate <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else n_miss / length(S_true)

    ## redundancy mass (not normalized on purpose)
    n_noise <- length(setdiff(S_down, S_true))

    neg_score <- miss_rate + lambda * n_noise

    res <- rbind(
      res,
      data.frame(
        experiment = e,
        step = ifelse(is.null(step), "all", step),
        top_x = length(S_true),
        miss_rate = miss_rate,
        noise_mass = n_noise,
        lambda = lambda,
        negative_score = neg_score,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  res
}
```

```{r}
score_downstream <- function(de_list,
                             A,
                             exp_design,
                             step = NULL,
                             top_x = NULL,
                             exp_subset = NULL) {

  genes <- colnames(exp_design)
  gene_to_idx <- setNames(seq_along(genes), genes)
  N_nodes <- length(genes)

  ## base regularization weight
  lambda_base <- 2 / N_nodes

  ## graph-wide mean out-degree (overall connectivity level)
  mean_degree <- mean(rowSums(A))

  ## effective penalty strength
  lambda <- lambda_base * mean_degree

  exps <- names(de_list)
  if (!is.null(exp_subset)) {
    exps <- intersect(exps, exp_subset)
  }

  res <- data.frame()

  for (e in exps) {

    dt <- de_list[[e]]
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next

    if (!is.null(top_x)) {
      dt <- head(dt, top_x)
    }

    ## true DEGs
    S_true <- dt$gene

    ## perturbed nodes
    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[exp_design[e, ] != 0]
    pert_idx <- gene_to_idx[pert_genes]

    ## downstream set
    S_down_idx <- if (is.null(step)) {
      all_downstream(A, pert_idx)
    } else {
      k_hop_descendants(A, pert_idx, k = step)
    }

    S_down_idx <- setdiff(S_down_idx, pert_idx)
    S_down <- genes[S_down_idx]

    ## causal violation
    n_miss <- length(setdiff(S_true, S_down))
    miss_rate <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else n_miss / length(S_true)

    ## redundancy / noise mass
    n_noise <- length(setdiff(S_down, S_true))

    ## regularized score
    neg_score <- miss_rate + lambda 

    res <- rbind(
      res,
      data.frame(
        experiment = e,
        step = ifelse(is.null(step), "all", step),
        top_x = length(S_true),
        miss_rate = miss_rate,
        noise_mass = n_noise,
        mean_degree = mean_degree,
        lambda = lambda,
        negative_score = neg_score,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  res
}
```

```{r}
calc_scores_for_graphs <- function(graph_list,
                                   de_list,
                                   exp_design,
                                   top_x_vals,
                                   exp_subset = NULL,
                                   step = NULL,
                                   graph_group = NULL) {
  # graph_list: named list of adjacency matrices
  # de_list: list of DE tables by experiment
  # exp_design: design matrix (rows=experiments, cols=genes)
  # top_x_vals: vector, e.g. seq(10, 50, by = 10)
  # exp_subset: optional vector of experiment names
  # step: NULL means all upstream (as in your score_negative_upstream)
  # graph_group: optional label for grouping, e.g. "low"/"high"

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(graph_list), function(name) {
    A <- graph_list[[name]]

    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(top_x_vals, function(tx) {
      score_downstream(
        de_list   = de_list,
        A         = A,
        exp_design = exp_design,
        step      = step,
        top_x     = tx,
        exp_subset = exp_subset
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          graph = name,
          graph_group = graph_group,
          top_x = tx
        )
    }))
  }))
}
```

```{r}
    )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
```

```{r}
correct_fracs <- seq(0.01, 1, by = 0.05)
n_rep <- 10
step_vals <- c(1, 2, 3)
tx_vals <- c(10, 20, 30)

results <- list()

for (cf in correct_fracs) {
  for (r in seq_len(n_rep)) {

    A_part <- make_partial_graph(adj_truth, cf, seed = r)

    for (st in step_vals) {
      for (tx in tx_vals) {

        sc <- score_downstream(
          de_top200_q50,
          A_part,
          exp_design,
          step = st,
          top_x = tx,
          exp_subset = test_exp
        )

        results[[length(results) + 1]] <- sc %>%
          mutate(
            correct_frac = cf,
            rep = r,
            step = st,
            top_x = tx
          )
      }
    }
  }
}

sens_df <- bind_rows(results)
```

```{r}
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("Penalized Causal Reach Violation (mean out-degree)") +
  xlab("Fraction of correct edges")

print(p)
```

```{r}
 box_stats <- sens_df %>%
  group_by(step, top_x, correct_frac) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score   = mean(negative_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(negative_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_score    = max(negative_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_score    = min(negative_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(step, top_x, correct_frac)
```

```{r}
box_deltas <- box_stats %>%
  group_by(step, top_x) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_delta   = mean_score   - lag(mean_score),
    median_delta = median_score - lag(median_score),
    max_delta    = max_score    - lag(max_score),
    min_delta    = min_score    - lag(min_score),
    x_frac = correct_frac
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_delta)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
central_long <- box_deltas %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_delta, median_delta),
    names_to = "stat",
    values_to = "delta"
  )

p1 <- ggplot(central_long, aes(x = x_frac, y = delta, color = stat)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_grid(step ~ top_x) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  xlab("Larger edge-correctness fraction") +
  ylab("Δ summary statistic (CRVm)") +
  ggtitle("Consecutive edge-correctness differences: mean & median")

print(p1)
```

```{r}
print(p1)
```
